## File Hash

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256, BLAKE3, CRC32 or XXH3 checksums of files or text.

```sh
dogubako files hash [files…] [options]
```

Id `files.hash` · MCP `files_hash` · Output: structured data · Timeout 60 min

Also found by: checksum, hash, md5, sha256, sha1, sha512, blake3, crc32, xxhash, digest, integrity

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | positional | files |  | Files. |
| `text` | `--text` | text (multi-line) |  | Hash this text (UTF-8) instead of / in addition to files. |
| `algorithms` | `--algorithms` | list of choices | `sha256` | Any of: `md5`, `sha1` (SHA-1), `sha256` (SHA-256), `sha512` (SHA-512), `sha3-256`, `blake3`, `crc32`, `xxh3` (XXH3-64). |
| `uppercase` | `--uppercase` | boolean | `false` | Uppercase hex. *Advanced.* |

## Verify Checksums

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Check files against a pasted checksum list (sha256sum/md5sum/BSD format) or a single expected hash; the algorithm is detected from the hash length.

```sh
dogubako files checksum-verify <files…> --checksums <checksums>
```

Id `files.checksum_verify` · MCP `files_checksum_verify` · Output: structured data · Timeout 60 min

Also found by: verify, checksum, integrity, sha256sum, md5sum, download, compare hash

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Files. |
| `checksums` *(required)* | `--checksums` | text (multi-line) |  | Paste a SHA256SUMS-style list or a single hash. |

## Checksum Manifest

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>reads host folders</span><span>progress</span></div>

Hash every file in a folder and produce a SHA256SUMS-style manifest (plus JSON) for later verification.


Id `files.checksum_manifest` · MCP `files_checksum_manifest` · Output: files · Timeout 360 min

Also found by: sha256sums, manifest, checksums, folder, integrity, backup, verify

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` *(required)* | positional | folder path |  | Folder. |
| `algorithm` | `--algorithm` | choice | `sha256` | One of: `md5`, `sha1` (SHA-1), `sha256` (SHA-256), `sha512` (SHA-512), `sha3-256`, `blake3`, `crc32`, `xxh3` (XXH3-64). |
| `skip_hidden` | `--skip-hidden` | boolean | `false` | Skip hidden files and folders. *Advanced.* |

## Extract Archive

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Safely unpack zip, tar(.gz/.bz2/.xz/.zst), gz/bz2/xz/zst, 7z and rar archives; path traversal, links and decompression bombs are blocked.

```sh
dogubako files archive-extract <file> [options]
```

Id `files.archive_extract` · MCP `files_archive_extract` · Output: files · Timeout 360 min

Also found by: unzip, extract, untar, decompress, unpack, 7z, rar, tar.gz, tgz, archive

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Archive. Accepts .zip .tar .tgz .gz .tbz .tbz2 .bz2 .txz .xz .zst +14 more. |
| `output` | `--output` | choice | `auto` | Automatic returns individual files for up to 50 files, otherwise a single zip. One of: `auto` (Automatic), `files` (Individual files), `zip` (One zip (keeps folders)). |
| `password` | `--password` | secret |  | For encrypted zip / 7z / rar archives. *Advanced.* |
| `max_size_mb` | `--max-size-mb` | integer ≥ 1 |  | Stop if the archive expands beyond this (capped by the instance limit). *Advanced.* |

## Create Archive

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Files. |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `zip` | One of: `zip`, `tar.gz`, `tar.xz`, `tar.zst`, `tar.bz2`, `tar` (tar (uncompressed)), `7z`. |
| `zip_method` | `--zip-method` | choice | `deflate` | One of: `deflate` (Deflate (compatible)), `zstd` (Zstandard), `bzip2`, `store` (Store (no compression)). Only used when `format` is `zip`. *Advanced.* |
| `level` | `--level` | integer 0–22 |  | Higher is smaller but slower (format-specific range; empty = default). *Advanced.* |
| `password` | `--password` | secret |  | Encrypt the zip (AES-256) or 7z archive. *Advanced.* |
| `name` | `--name` | text | `archive` | Archive name. |

## Batch Rename

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>reads host folders</span><span>changes host files</span><span>changes files (preview first)</span></div>

Rename many files at once with templates ({name}, {ext}, {n:03}, {date}), regex find/replace, case changes and numbering; previews by default.

```sh
dogubako files batch-rename [path] [options]
```

Id `files.batch_rename` · MCP `files_batch_rename` · Output: structured data · Timeout 30 min

Also found by: rename, batch rename, bulk rename, mass rename, numbering, regex, files

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | positional | folder path |  | Rename the files directly inside this folder. |
| `files` | `--files` | text (multi-line) |  | One file path per line (instead of a folder). *Advanced.* |
| `filter` | `--filter` | text |  | Glob, e.g. '\*.jpg' (folder mode). |
| `template` | `--template` | text | `{name}{ext}` | Placeholders: {name} (name without extension), {ext} (extension incl. dot), {n} / {n:03} (counter), {date} (modified date), {parent}, {original}. |
| `find` | `--find` | text |  | Applied to {name}. |
| `replace` | `--replace` | text |  | Use $1, $2 for capture groups. |
| `case` | `--case` | choice | `keep` | One of: `keep`, `lower` (lowercase), `upper` (UPPERCASE), `title` (Title Case). |

| `step` | `--step` | integer | `1` | Counter step. *Advanced.* |
| `sort` | `--sort` | choice | `name` | Numbering order. One of: `name`, `modified` (Modified time), `size`. *Advanced.* |
| `apply` | `--apply` | boolean | `false` | Off = preview only. On = perform the renames (never overwrites). |
